name: Closing Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the timing or method for terminating the agreement - for repos.

OVER.name: Overnight
OVER.definition: Repo with a term of one day.

TERM.name: Term
TERM.definition: Repo with a term of more than one day.

FLEX.name: Flexible
FLEX.definition: Identifies "a classic term repo with the added feature that the cash is repaid to the buyer in installments" (Definition from "Mastering Repo Markets" by Bob Steiner).

OPEN.name: Open
OPEN.definition: Repo which can be terminated by either party at any time, and which has an unspecified repurchase date.
